problem: A valid fresh SEO status snapshot was stranded on a stale writer branch and a first recovery successor was routed through the bounded paginacontrole writer contract, causing a false delivery failure because the snapshot legitimately exceeded the 50-line writer impact budget.
root_cause: Recovery preserved the content but initially selected the wrong delivery identity. The writer/ prefix invoked writer-specific path and impact constraints intended for deterministic small repairs rather than a current-main recovery of an already-generated status artifact.
prevention: Use a normal fix/ recovery branch when carrying an already-generated large status snapshot onto current main.
Preserve the predecessor obligation id across direct supersession so delivery hygiene sees one lineage.
Do not bypass protected checks; use an empty synchronize commit only to rerun corrected metadata with an unchanged tree.
failed_approaches: Routing the large SEO snapshot through writer/paginacontrole.
Changing the obligation id while declaring a direct predecessor, which produced ambiguous lineage.
